answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch. Circuit breaking would fail fast and drop customer writes, which violates the objective. Read-replica routing (b5) addressed report/read load, not this write-path p99. Add-capacity (b3) is a weak fit while the fault is confined to the primary region and may be code or regional rather than a global headroom gap. That regional confinement is the actionable signal and matches the March failover precedent (b2), so that is the one record to verify. Cause is still uncertain (staged patch vs primary-region infra), and a full cutover during settlement peak risks in-flight writes, so only a guarded traffic shift is justified until b2 is confirmed.
